selection_rule: Use the four proposed benchmark assets if present and visually suitable, covering chart/graphics, complex coastal photography, fine organic subject detail, and broad smooth photographic gradients. Do not select from Pass 34 results.
global_independence_note: All four are established PBC benchmark assets and have earlier benchmark use. Filename searches found no Pass 33 sparse-transform evaluation of these images; this is a representation-specific holdout, not a globally unseen dataset.

images.selection_rationale: A compact plotted RD chart with colored curves, axes, labels, and thin lines; selected to test palette-like graphics and text edges.
A wide shoreline scene with strong silhouettes, horizon geometry, bright point details, and a large smooth sunset sky.
Two birds with fine feather edges against both smooth and textured foreground/background regions.
A portrait sunset dominated by broad sky and water gradients, with silhouettes, birds, shoreline and specular water detail.
